description: Nuance / grace. Focus on your own life #selflove #selfcare #selfimprovement
transcript: I don't care about things enough to critique them. There are a million different perspectives for one thing, and it is not my place to be an expert on all things. Most things don't require my opinion. Find ourselves that just because we see things, we don't have to respond to them. The ability to move in grace is such a lost art. Find grace and lean upon it.
